type Op = Put string int | Append int | Noop
let execute script =
  let step acc op =
    match acc:
      case (puts, total):
        match op:
          case Put _ v: (puts + 1, total + v)
          case Append n: (puts, total + n)
          case Noop: acc
  List.fold step (0, 0) script

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List St) Val
type St = Set string Val | Show Val
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold exec env body) last
let exec env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env
print (value Map.empty (Block [Set "a" (Lit 6), Set "b" (Plus (Ref "a") (Lit 1)), Show (Ref "b")] (Plus (Ref "a") (Ref "shown"))))

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List St) Val
type St = Set string Val | Show Val
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold runSt env body) last
let runSt env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env

type Delta = Put string int | Append int | Noop
let execute script =
  let step acc op =
    match acc:
      case (m, xs):
        match op:
          case Put k v: (Map.add k v m, xs)
          case Append n: (m, List.concat xs [n])
          case Noop: acc
  List.fold step (Map.empty, []) script

module Perhaps =
  let bind m f =
    match m:
      case Some x: f x
      case None: None
  let return_ x = Some x
